title: The Crooked Circle
subtitle: A Sinister Scheme Unfolds in Calcutta
summary: When a desperate doctor seeks Byomkesh Bakshi’s help for a gravely ill patient, a web of mystery and intrigue begins to unravel. Reluctant yet intrigued, Byomkesh is drawn into a case where nothing is as it seems, and danger lurks beneath the surface. Will his razor-sharp intellect uncover the truth before it’s too late?
